reason: On a record page, the "More like this" block is computed (three nearest posts sharing a use case), so adding a record to the column can displace one of the three. That is a recommendation changing, not a navigation link being dropped: the displaced page is still linked from the column hub, from the sitemap, and from its own related blocks. 2026-09-24, when batch 1 added twenty records and the guard read it as seventeen dropped links. The block itself is now marked `data-generated`, which makes this exemption redundant on the live site once this build has shipped — kept because the guard compares against production, and production will keep changing under us.

The front page was split on 2026-09-24: the long reference moved to /typesafe-jev/reference, and the sentence that carried this link (the CC BY 4.0 licence paragraph, which points at the Alpha Line Report as the other machine-readable report) moved with it. The link is not dropped from the site — it is on the new page, which production has never had, so the guard cannot see it and reads the move as a deletion. Restoring the sentence here would mean keeping an appendix paragraph on a cover page to satisfy a link checker.

Same split, same day, one level down: /typesafe-jev/use-cases became the section's front door (six facet cards, wide) and the explainer that cites these three rows moved to /typesafe-jev/use-cases/jobs. The rows are still linked from the page that cites them — a page production has never seen, so the guard counts the move as three deletions.
